cards.title: Would more hands-on dads create a more peaceful world?
cards.body: Primatologist Sarah Blaffer Hrdy has rewritten the story of evolution by unpicking Darwinian sexism. Now she's turned her attention to exploring how involved fatherhood might shape society and child development.

cards.title: Parents: please don't buy Grand Theft Auto VI for your child
cards.body: Rockstar Games' 18-rated game is stuffed with explicit sex, drugs, and violence—the most graphic content the reviewer has encountered. It's absolutely not appropriate for children, despite its popularity.

cards.title: My son's back home – and my mothering skills have gone out of the window
cards.body: A graduate son has returned to the family home for five months, forcing parents to renegotiate the relationship after the extended holiday phase. The adjustment requires new approaches to daily life together.

cards.title: 3 Signs Your Adult Child's Problems Are Draining Your Life
cards.body: Worrying about your adult child's life 24/7 can interfere with living your own life. Learning to set boundaries is essential for your wellbeing and theirs.

cards.title: Why fibbing about stolen snacks is an important part of childhood
cards.body: Research shows lies and deception can start surprisingly young and aren't always harmful to child development. Small fibs are often a normal part of growing up.
